experiences.description:
ICEE Social is a boutique development agency specializing in the development of Shopify E-commerce Stores. Our trustworthy and highly-rated concierge shop has built (and continues to manage) hundreds of Shopify stores over the past 10 years, maintaining our status as a top 10 Shopify Partner/Expert. 

The best part of our  job is helping businesses take an idea (whether it be fledgling or fully formed), and flesh it out to develop a fully functioning business.
